svg.title: Freelingo node — jump here, active
svg.desc: Original work for Freelingo (AGPL-3.0). Flat plate with the measured 3D lip (deep/08 §2): the lip disc sits 16 units below the face disc, which is the 4 px lip at the 64 px node size. Two stacked chevrons pointing up the path, because a jump-here test moves the learner forward past the nodes above it. Product map: S019.
